caption: The drawing depicts a headless, armless, and footless mannequin-like form dressed in a long, dark, possibly black or deep charcoal skirt and a matching fitted jacket. The jacket has long sleeves, a double-breasted front with four visible buttons, and is slightly flared at the hips. The jacket also features lapels and appears to be tailored. Underneath the jacket, a high-collared light-colored shirt is visible, adorned at the neck with a small, round brooch or pin, and a short section of patterned fabric or vest peeks out just above the waistband of the skirt. The background is a plain, light beige, with areas showing faint brownish discoloration or stains, and there are no additional objects or features present in the composition.
title: Woman's Riding Habit
